blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Plan A costs fifteen dollars plus four dollars a visit. Plan B costs seven dollars a visit. After how many visits do they cost the same? Let v be the number of visits, so fifteen plus four v equals seven v.
Gather the v terms. Subtract four v from both sides. Fifteen equals three v.
Divide both sides by three. v equals five. At five visits, both plans cost thirty-five dollars.
Watch out for these traps. If you add four v instead of subtracting it, you get fifteen over eleven. If you multiply by three instead of dividing, you get forty-five.
